segments.name: Sanara Surgical
segments.description: Develops and sells soft tissue repair and bone fusion surgical products to hospitals, ambulatory surgical centers and surgeons in the U.S. surgical market.
segments.evidence: We primarily market and sell soft tissue repair and bone fusion products for use in the operating room or other sterile environments.

revenueModel.text: Hospitals and ambulatory surgical centers purchase the company's surgical products for use by surgeons treating surgical wounds.
revenueModel.evidence: CellerateRX Surgical is primarily purchased by hospitals and ambulatory surgical centers for use by surgeons to treat surgical wounds, including those associated with orthopedic, spine and trauma procedures.

changes.text: In 2024 the company began managing its business on the basis of two reportable segments, Sanara Surgical and THP.
changes.evidence: Since the second quarter of 2024, we managed our business on the basis of two operating and reportable segments: the Sanara Surgical segment and the THP segment.

changes.text: In 2025 the company discontinued the THP segment's operations and returned to a single reportable segment.
changes.evidence: Persistent losses related to THP and a lack of any firm commitments from potential investors led management and our Board of Directors to decide to discontinue THP's operations in mid-September 2025 and shift our focus exclusively on products and technologies for use in the surgical market.
